criteria.name: LangChain fundamentals
criteria.description: Models created with init_chat_model, prompts built with templates, chains composed with LCEL rather than string concatenation.

criteria.name: Structured output
criteria.description: Pydantic schemas with clear field descriptions, typed results from with_structured_output, and a sensible handling path for parsing failures.

criteria.name: Correct logic split
criteria.description: Extraction runs in parallel with RunnableParallel, and the match score is computed deterministically in Python, not by the model.

criteria.name: Usability & documentation
criteria.description: Runs from the command line with arguments, produces a readable report, and the README explains architecture, usage and limits.

criteria.name: Indexing pipeline
criteria.description: Loading, chunking and embedding are separated from chat, metadata is preserved, and duplicate ingestion is avoided.

criteria.name: Retrieval quality
criteria.description: A test set and hit-rate measurements justify the chosen retrieval method (MMR, hybrid, multi-query or reranking).

criteria.name: Grounded answers
criteria.description: Answers cite numbered sources, stay within the context, and return NOT_FOUND honestly when the documents do not cover the question.

criteria.name: App experience
criteria.description: Streamlit app with upload, chat history, streaming, visible sources, a screenshot and a clear README.

criteria.name: Tool design
criteria.description: Small, well-described tools, including earlier projects reused as tools, with errors returned to the model rather than crashing.

criteria.name: Agent behaviour
criteria.description: Sensible tool selection, no unnecessary retrieval, memory per thread_id, and a system prompt with explicit rules.

criteria.name: Testing
criteria.description: Scripted conversations with expected tools, a measured tool-choice accuracy and at least one documented fix.

criteria.name: Capstone proposal
criteria.description: A clear problem, user, inputs and outputs, a first graph sketch, reuse plan and realistic risks.

criteria.name: Graph design
criteria.description: State, nodes and conditional edges match a documented diagram, and every loop has an explicit limit.

criteria.name: Self-correction
criteria.description: Retrieved chunks are graded, weak queries are rewritten, and answers are checked for groundedness before returning.

criteria.name: Comparison with plain RAG
criteria.description: A 10-question comparison covering correct, NOT_FOUND and hallucinated answers plus the extra LLM calls per question.

criteria.name: Code & documentation
criteria.description: Readable node functions, a Mermaid diagram in the README and honest discussion of cost.

criteria.name: Evaluation
criteria.description: A LangSmith dataset, a code evaluator and an LLM-as-judge evaluator, two compared experiments and a written diagnosis of failures.

criteria.name: Security & guardrails
criteria.description: A tested prompt injection defence, input limits, PII redaction, secrets kept out of the repo and a completed checklist.

criteria.name: Serving & deployment
criteria.description: A FastAPI service with validated input and a streaming endpoint, a Dockerfile and a working deployment documented in DEPLOY.md.

criteria.name: Architecture & LangGraph use
criteria.description: A design document and graph that use state, reducers, conditional routing, interrupts and persistence where they are genuinely needed.

criteria.name: Functionality
criteria.description: End-to-end interview works: extraction, planning, topic-filtered questions, rubric-based evaluation, bounded follow-ups and a final report.

criteria.name: Evaluation & robustness
criteria.description: Evaluator band accuracy, persona runs, an injection test inside uploaded documents and documented weaknesses.

criteria.name: Deployment & presentation
criteria.description: A live deployment, a portfolio-quality README, a 10-point demo video and an honest retrospective.
